title: Professional, Adaptable, Flexible, Knowledgable.
text: David is Expertise, Professionalism, and Punctuality... all wrapped up in a fun flexible personality that adapted to our family's desires on-the-fly. David met up with us on our first night; he oriented us to the city (the Gothic Quarter, el Born, Las Ramblas)  and made perfect recommendations for the remainder of our stay. We met up again later in the week for a fantastic tour of Montserrat; he kept both parents and the teen engaged. His knowledge runs deep. title: Great tour with an even better guide!
text: David took our family of five on a walking tour of Sagrada Familia and Old City.  He was wonderful and added so much detail to our experience.   I have never been awe struck like when we walked into Sagrada Familia.  David’s tour helped us understand the history of Spain and Gaudi’s influence around the city. It was the perfect tour with an enthusiastic and personable guide!  I highly highly recommend!
author: beachtraveler007

title: Absolutely incredible!
text: This tour was above and beyond expectations! David did an excellent job of explaining the history of the city, pointing out so many details that we would have obliviously walked past, and he made it so fun and enjoyable! He is an absolute expert and such a pleasure to spend time with. We are so grateful for this experience and highly recommend adding this tour to your trip!
author: jessicalB4230TY

title: Great Guide, Great Tour!
text: We booked this tour for our first day in Barcelona. It’s a great overview of the Gothic area and David was the perfect guide. He is very knowledgeable and explained the history behind the places we visited. He was very respectful of our time and tailored our tour so we could spend more time at the Sagrada Familia. When we arrived at the church, there was a women’s choir performing, which made our experience very special. We highly recommend a tour with David! Great communication, and a very enjoyable morning with a really nice guide! You don’t want to miss this one!
author: Lisa_C

title: Excellent Barcelona Tour with David- Sagrada Familia a must.
text:
David is great to work with and knows the city very well. His extensive knowledge of Barcelona helped us expand our understanding of the history and development of the city and the Gothic Quarter in particular. We saw Roman ruins we would have missed on our own and he even shared insights about local artists and favorite cafes. Seeing Sagrada Familia with him was a highlight as he has a passion for this sight which he shares and he explained and called our attention to the many details of the architecture and art. I wish I could return there already.

title: Entertaining and informative
text: David was a very good tour guide a wealth of knowledge on the Gothic quarter and a veritable walking encyclopedia at the Sagrada Família!!  he provided great suggestions of places to eat, and things to do. Very personable and fun to talk to as well. We highly recommend David if you were going to take a guided tour.
